package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for count_then_find_same_filter: Request-path GORM flows that run Count(...) and then a broad Find(...) with the same filter shape.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule251PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}

func scenario251Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) (int64, []Rule251PositiveRecord, error) {
	var total int64
	filter := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID)
	if err := filter.Model(&Rule251PositiveRecord{}).Count(&total).Error; err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	var items []Rule251PositiveRecord
	if err := filter.Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	return total, items, nil
}
